text: 金十数据10月24日讯，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁24日陪同朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员会委员长金正恩访问丹东，转达习近平总书记、国家主席的亲切问候和良好祝愿。在双方会见中，王沪宁表示，中方愿同朝方一道，坚定不移贯彻落实两党两国最高领导人重要共识，以共同的社会主义事业为纽带，推动中朝关系进一步升华发展。以中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通为契机，拓展人员往来和经贸合作，更好造福两国人民。加强战略沟通协作，为捍卫各自主权、安全和发展利益营造和平稳定的外部环境。
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 24: Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the CPPCC, accompanied Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, on a visit to Dandong on the 24th, conveying the cordial greetings and best wishes of General Secretary and President Xi Jinping. During their meeting, Wang Huning said that China is willing to work with the DPRK to unswervingly implement the important consensus of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, and, with the common cause of socialism as a bond, promote the further elevation and development of China-DPRK relations. Taking the opening of the new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge as an opportunity, the two sides should expand personnel exchanges and economic and trade cooperation to better benefit the people of both countries. They should strengthen strategic communication and coordination to foster a peaceful and stable external environment for safeguarding their respective sovereignty, security and development interests.
